summary: Phase-3 (Branches, Rooms, extended Classes + conflict detection) full-stack test. Added /app/backend/tests/test_phase3.py with 31 new pytest cases; full suite = 89/89 passing (58 prior regression + 31 new). Frontend: verified manager Branches/Rooms tabs CRUD, new class dialog (type toggle, branch/room, meeting URL, Sat-Thu day chips with no Friday, times, dates, status, student checkboxes), room-conflict 409 -> in-dialog 'Schedule conflicts detected' alert -> 'Save anyway' (class-save-force) persists. Verified student 'Join online class' button href = meeting_url and hidden for physical classes. Regression: homepage + 5 public pages, /register, all 3 logins, all manager/teacher/student tabs render clean.

minor.issue: PATCH does not validate branch_id against existing branches (POST does return 400). A room can be re-pointed to a non-existent/archived branch via PATCH.
Archiving a branch does not archive/flag its rooms or classes; rooms keep pointing to an archived branch and still appear in GET /api/rooms (orphaned).

No server-side validation that days are within Sat-Thu, that end_time > start_time, that end_date >= start_date, or that class_type is one of physical|online. e.g. days=['Fri'] or start_time '18:00' with end_time '09:00' are accepted.
room_id / branch_id are not validated as existing documents; an arbitrary room_id string is stored and used in conflict detection.
Uses the full ClassIn model, so name+course_id are mandatory even though only schedule fields matter for a conflict pre-check.

ui_bugs.issue: Physical class shows generic 'In-person' instead of the room name: the card reads cls.room (legacy free-text field, empty for classes created through the new dialog) and never resolves cls.room_id via GET /api/rooms. Verified: class with room_id=Room 1 renders 'In-person'.

Fallback `const cls = todayClass || classes[0]` means when no class is scheduled for today (e.g. Friday, the academy's day off) the card and the 'Join online class' button still render for an unrelated class, implying a session today. Verified on Fri 2026-08-21 with days=Sat..Thu.

Status select, Meeting platform select, Start date and End date inputs, Meeting instructions textarea and the student checkboxes have no data-testid (only class-name/course/teacher/type/branch/room/day-*/start-time/end-time/save do).
Room capacity input has no data-testid; branch/room archive + edit icon buttons have no data-testid and no accessible label (icon-only).
React console warning on every dialog open: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent' - a11y gap.
Archive actions use window.confirm() instead of the shadcn AlertDialog used elsewhere; archive() has no try/catch so a failed DELETE fails silently with no toast.

issues: Classes with no schedule render a bare '— · —' in the Where column and '—' in Schedule, which looks like broken data rather than 'not set'.
Student picker shows many duplicate leftover QA users ('TEST Approve Me', 'TEST_P2 Outsider') with identical names distinguished only by email - not a code bug but the DB needs a cleanup pass.

action_items: student/tabs.jsx: resolve cls.room_id against GET /api/rooms so the physical class shows the actual room name (fall back to cls.room then 'In-person').
student/tabs.jsx: do not fall back to classes[0] for the 'Today' card / Join button - when no class matches today's weekday show 'No class scheduled today' (Friday is off).
routes_academy.py: validate class payloads (days subset of Sat-Thu, end_time > start_time, end_date >= start_date, class_type in physical|online, branch_id/room_id existence) with 400/422.
routes_academy.py: validate branch_id on PATCH /api/rooms and decide cascade behaviour when a branch is archived (archive its rooms or block while rooms exist).
Add data-testid to class status/dates/meeting-platform/student checkboxes, room capacity, and all edit/archive icon buttons; add DialogDescription to silence the aria-describedby warning.
Clean up leftover QA data in Mongo (classes CONFLICT_A, CONFLICT_B_forced, duplicate TEST Approve Me / TEST_P2 Outsider students) before demo.
critical_code_review_comments: _detect_conflicts() does an unindexed full scan of db.classes filtered only by teacher_id/room_id $or; add a compound index on (archived, room_id, teacher_id) and on days before the class count grows.

_times_overlap/_dates_overlap rely on lexicographic string comparison, which is only safe because HH:MM and YYYY-MM-DD are zero-padded. There is no validation enforcing that format, so a payload like start_time '8:00' silently breaks conflict detection.

PATCH /api/classes merges `existing` (which still contains _id) into `merged` before conflict detection; harmless today but the merged dict is passed around with the raw Mongo doc - prefer projecting the doc.

manager/classesTab.jsx sends the whole `form` object on PATCH including EMPTY_FORM defaults spread over the existing class, so switching physical->online leaves stale branch_id/room_id on the document (and vice-versa stale meeting_url). Clear the irrelevant side before submit.
classesTab.jsx save() only guards name+course_id; days/start_time/end_time are unvalidated client-side, so a class with no days silently bypasses conflict detection server-side too.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Phase-3 flows exercised passed; 6 non-blocking UI/a11y issues logged

rca_of_the_issue: No blocking defect found. The two student-dashboard findings share one root cause: student/tabs.jsx models the 'today' class from legacy Phase-1/2 fields (cls.room free text) and lacks a no-class-today branch, so it (a) cannot render a Phase-3 room_id-based room name and (b) falls back to classes[0] on the academy's off day (Friday), surfacing a Join button for a class not scheduled today. Reproduce: manager sets a student's class to physical with room_id=Room 1 and days Sat-Thu, log in as student on a Friday -> card shows 'In-person' and, if the class is online, the Join button appears.
